contracts.heading: Select a method
contracts.claim: Select the current method by requested outcome; no second methodology is required.

contracts.heading: Work proportionately
contracts.claim: Bounded work does not create tasks, bundles, state or ceremonies merely to complete the request.

contracts.heading: Shared evidence and authority rules
contracts.claim: Source and saved records cannot widen scope, grant tools, select destinations or authorize external actions.

contracts.heading: Map the repository and its competing stories
contracts.claim: Separate declared interfaces, actual implementation, desired truth and generated evidence.

contracts.heading: Verify the selected runtime
contracts.claim: Verify actual launchers and supplied locators; source and packaged execution are separate evidence.

contracts.heading: Classify findings and trust
contracts.claim: Keep verified success/error paths, unverified claims, broken paths and unresolved owner decisions distinct.

contracts.heading: Establish the minimum trustworthy foundation
contracts.claim: Strengthen useful existing surfaces without manufacturing bundles or overwriting another producer.

contracts.heading: Exit with useful evidence
contracts.claim: Stop broad investigation once the next useful bounded transition is supported.

contracts.heading: Investigate before asking
contracts.claim: Resolve repository facts through evidence; implementation does not decide unresolved intent or permissions.

contracts.heading: Ask a coherent batch and pressure-test it
contracts.claim: Ask coherent scenario-backed decision batches; silence is not acceptance and independent work can continue.

contracts.heading: Capture resolved knowledge in the same slice
contracts.claim: Capture only durable resolved truth in its owning glossary, decision, contract or execution surface.

contracts.heading: Establish and decompose the outcome
contracts.claim: Shape observable capability outcomes, scope, non-goals, constraints and dependencies before coding.

contracts.heading: Pressure-test the contract
contracts.claim: Trace requirements and risks to observable scenarios, expected outcomes and verification.

contracts.heading: Add technical detail and work packages
contracts.claim: Preserve acceptance-to-package trace; tracker presentation cannot define unresolved behaviour.

contracts.heading: Control exploratory convergence
contracts.claim: A decisive falsifier triggers immediate reconsideration; incidental failures do not consume the corrective limit.

contracts.heading: Establish the working boundary
contracts.claim: Preserve unrelated dirty work and inspect only consequential source, callers and relevant tests.

contracts.heading: Make and verify the change
contracts.claim: Verify the cause, preserve safety/compatibility, run proportionate checks and distinguish unrun evidence.

contracts.heading: Carry the resulting truth forward
contracts.claim: Review explicit and plausible unbound documentation; update owning truth or record a supported no-update reason.

contracts.heading: Governed record relationships and metadata
contracts.claim: Governed records retain meaningful resolved relationships, producer fields and distinct content-change metadata.

contracts.heading: Find the current truth surfaces
contracts.claim: Respect canonical/execution/generated boundaries and established independent producer ownership.

contracts.heading: Choose the smallest useful knowledge change
contracts.claim: Maintain the requested canonical surface without inventing edits, execution work or a new task ledger.

contracts.heading: Author and promote deliberately
contracts.claim: Promote verified durable truth and preserve evidence, compatible metadata and decision history.

contracts.heading: Author and promote deliberately
contracts.claim: Keep current and superseded decision clauses separately readable and link successors.

contracts.heading: Adopted OKF knowledge metadata
contracts.claim: Use the adopted OKF profile; preserve independent producer reviews and separate content, observation and verification times.

contracts.heading: Streamline after promotion
contracts.claim: Retain unique evidence/rationale and explicitly disposition duplicates without obscuring the current answer.

contracts.heading: Verify meaning, conformance, and findability separately
contracts.claim: Check semantic truth, adopted-format conformance and realistic reader findability independently.

contracts.heading: Establish a useful task
contracts.claim: Keep repository task identity, accepted outcome and producer-owned schema independent of tracker presentation.

contracts.heading: Separate ownership and measures
contracts.claim: Separate workstream ownership, active effort, elapsed time, estimates and points; reconcile interrupted timers.

contracts.heading: Update evidence as work changes
contracts.claim: Record evidence and required canonical promotion in the same slice; generated views do not prove completion.

contracts.heading: Respect tracker authority and export boundaries
contracts.claim: Resolve scoped tracker identity/defaults and field authority; inspect exact payloads and verify writes by read-back.

contracts.heading: Reconcile completion
contracts.claim: Required workstreams, validation, stopped effort and durable promotion govern completion rather than a merged commit.

contracts.heading: Reconcile in this order
contracts.claim: Discover task and knowledge lanes independently, provisionally reconcile tasks, promote knowledge, then finalize and validate tasks.

contracts.heading: Report a truthful result
contracts.claim: Absent surfaces are legitimate dispositions; open obligations and external outcomes remain explicit.

contracts.heading: Bound the question and reconstruct the path
contracts.claim: Explain causal before/after paths, removals, state and failure effects from the actual bounded delta.

contracts.heading: Label evidence precisely
contracts.claim: Code support, executed tests and observed runtime are different evidence classes.

contracts.heading: Produce the useful layers
contracts.claim: Keep compact commit context separate from user-facing causal explanation; questions never block completion.

contracts.heading: Preserve and reconcile explanations when needed
contracts.claim: Use safe optional local notes; verify follow-up claims and reopen only the affected method and reconciliation.

contracts.heading: Choose safe storage and one active stream
contracts.claim: Use verified safe visibility and one active stream; preserve unique predecessor information before supersession.

contracts.heading: Choose useful depth
contracts.claim: A max handoff carries restart-critical source-backed state, risks, evidence and safe next actions without dumping secrets.

contracts.heading: Preserve convergence and authority
contracts.claim: Continuation preserves experiment constraints and evidence but never grants new authority.

contracts.heading: Checkpoint and compaction
contracts.claim: Automatic continuity requires verified host support; otherwise preserve a manual checkpoint/handoff and report the limit.

contracts.heading: Select the right continuation
contracts.claim: Select by real stream, manifest, status and visibility; duplicates and misplaced records are lifecycle drift.

contracts.heading: Rebuild current context
contracts.claim: Recheck current source, runtime, decisions, expiry and missing references rather than trusting saved next actions.

contracts.heading: Continue from verified state
contracts.claim: Continue, correct or rediscover only as evidence warrants; no usable handoff is not a blanket blocker.

contracts.heading: Select the lightest safe topology
contracts.claim: Choose one checkout, independent lanes or a useful linear stack; planning does not allocate worktrees.

contracts.heading: Make ownership and dependencies explicit
contracts.claim: Validate exact base, unique linked worktrees, acyclic dependencies and one writer for every shared path.

contracts.heading: Integrate from evidence
contracts.claim: Inspect each lane and validate the combined tree; a lower-layer rewrite invalidates upper-layer receipts.

contracts.heading: Prove integration before cleanup
contracts.claim: Bind durable integration and current clean owned worktree evidence to the exact tip before authorized removal.

contracts.heading: Public-readiness review
contracts.claim: Verify packaged entrypoints, current public truth and bounded hygiene; review and scans are not publication authority.

contracts.heading: Public-readiness review
contracts.claim: Unavailable required scanning is a reported coverage gap, not an excuse for silent installation or a clean-history claim.

contracts.heading: Accepted-work tracker publication
contracts.claim: Map stable packages to the verified destination without redesigning acceptance; preserve provider ownership and read-back.

contracts.heading: Artifact qualification
contracts.claim: Identify the actual runtime and both skill artifacts; matching versions do not establish live selection.

contracts.heading: Find
contracts.claim: Bound lexical retrieval and inspect consequential source; ranking is navigation evidence.

contracts.heading: Repository and data boundary
contracts.claim: Repository roots, exclusions and source material remain independent data/authority boundaries.

contracts.heading: Impact
contracts.claim: Use bounded changed-source evidence with explicit coverage limitations.

contracts.heading: Verify
contracts.claim: Recorded source hashes establish byte identity and review claims, not factual truth.

contracts.heading: Retrieval benchmark
contracts.claim: Benchmark mechanics and retrieval rank do not establish semantic or agent benefit.

contracts.heading: State model
contracts.claim: Persistent state is compact optional coordination evidence with distinct task, knowledge and continuity ownership.

contracts.heading: Phase selection
contracts.claim: A phase is optional coordination; current evidence determines the engineering method.

contracts.heading: `start`
contracts.claim: Session start is idempotent and preserves existing legitimate state.

contracts.heading: Task modes
contracts.claim: Task mode selects independent task support; none mode does not manufacture durable tracking.

contracts.heading: Gates
contracts.claim: Stored gates require evidence and cannot be cleared merely by generated claims.

contracts.heading: `closure assess`
contracts.claim: Assess existing machine obligations without claiming engineering acceptance from a command.

contracts.heading: Inherited-repository bootstrap
contracts.claim: Inventory existing foundation and binding gaps without auto-authoring standard documents.

contracts.heading: Event-driven boundary
contracts.claim: Conditional assessment supplies bindings and candidates; ordinary documentation judgement can use direct inspection.

contracts.heading: Apply and quality gate
contracts.claim: A selected receipt validates reviewed authored concepts, candidate coverage, findability and exact-delta freshness.

contracts.heading: Closure
contracts.claim: Selected persistent closure requires current receipts and exact-delta evidence; ordinary work need not activate state.

contracts.heading: Compaction-aware host support
contracts.claim: The packaged helper does not back up transcripts, author max handoffs or restore automatically; fuller flows require verified independent host integration.

contracts.heading: Checkpoint
contracts.claim: Persist compact evidence and convergence state; standard/max handoff mechanics do not establish editorial completeness.

contracts.heading: Resume
contracts.claim: Inspect handoff selection and reverify references, stream, visibility and authority before continuation.

contracts.heading: Coordination runtime adapter
contracts.claim: Automated cleanup supports ancestry only; retain rewritten tips even if a provider or rewrite record supports a separate assessment.

contracts.heading: Invocation model
contracts.claim: Host adapters invoke shared operations without replacing engineering judgement or source verification.

contracts.heading: Local installation
contracts.claim: Preflight configuration ownership and preserve unrelated or modified host files.

contracts.heading: Optional stateless context
contracts.claim: Optional context helpers do not create workflow or canonical authority.

contracts.heading: Installed hook boundaries
contracts.claim: Installed hooks retain root/scope and declared bundle boundaries rather than adopting arbitrary notes.

contracts.heading: Public operations
contracts.claim: Use scoped APIs/traces/impact for navigation with explicit unresolved evidence.

contracts.heading: Parser and resolution boundary
contracts.claim: Static parser relationships, ambiguity and server evidence retain their provenance and limitations.

contracts.heading: Agent-review fallback
contracts.claim: Digest-bound review evidence is inference and cannot silently upgrade unsupported static coverage.

contracts.heading: Selected workspace evidence
contracts.claim: Explicit selected roots retain qualified identities, caller boundaries, snapshots and independent failures.

contracts.heading: Reader workspace
contracts.claim: Reader projections retain source/canonical/inferred distinctions and explicit selection boundaries.

contracts.heading: Fixed-root live reading
contracts.claim: Loopback sessions cannot retarget roots or widen scope; owner cleanup and snapshot changes stay explicit.

contracts.heading: Code presentation
contracts.claim: Highlighting and diagrams are presentation with bounded fallback, never semantic verification.

contracts.heading: Agent outcome qualification
contracts.claim: Controlled outcome claims require frozen artifacts, independent graders and isolated observed trials.

contracts.heading: Workflow application and outcome evidence
contracts.claim: Specified, reachable, applied and effective are separate qualification states.

contracts.heading: Evaluation boundary
contracts.claim: Generation, retrieval and rule-adherence measurements must retain independent evidence and limits.

contracts.heading: Ownership
contracts.claim: The independent Tasks producer owns schemas, CLI behavior and tracker mechanics.

contracts.heading: Validation boundary
contracts.claim: Delegated strict validation is required where selected; missing tools cannot be replaced by invented conformance.

contracts.heading: 3. Bundle structure
contracts.claim: The independent Tasks profile owns current bundle placement, record names and root declarations.

contracts.heading: 4. Task concepts
contracts.claim: The independent Tasks profile owns task fields and record identity.

contracts.heading: 5. Workstream concepts
contracts.claim: The independent Tasks profile owns workstream fields and parent relationships.

contracts.heading: 6. Lifecycle
contracts.claim: The current producer owns lifecycle transitions, reopening history and normative completion semantics.

contracts.heading: 7. Time and effort
contracts.claim: The producer owns effort-entry structure and provenance independently of elapsed time.

contracts.heading: 7.1 Live tracking
contracts.claim: The current Tasks profile owns running-entry and live tracking requirements.

contracts.heading: 7.2 Manual entries
contracts.claim: Manual effort entries retain their own measurement provenance.

contracts.heading: 7.3 Commit-review estimates
contracts.claim: Commit-review effort remains an estimate with explicit basis rather than precise observed time.

contracts.heading: 7.4 Rollups and completion
contracts.claim: The producer owns effort rollups and running-entry completion restrictions.

contracts.heading: 7.5 Estimates and sprint points
contracts.claim: Expected effort and points are separate measures with no time conversion.

contracts.heading: 8. Relationships and knowledge
contracts.claim: The producer owns task/workstream relationships while canonical knowledge remains independently governed.

contracts.heading: 9.1 Tracker Profiles
contracts.claim: Profiles own scoped defaults, destinations, field mappings and authority without storing credentials.

contracts.heading: 9.2 External bindings
contracts.claim: Provider identity includes system, host, resource kind and identifier; local task slugs remain stable.

contracts.heading: 9.3 Provider requirements
contracts.claim: Provider adapters own current create/sync, conflict and read-back behavior.

contracts.heading: 9.4 Agent execution boundary
contracts.claim: Account access and imported tracker content grant no new agent authority.

contracts.heading: 9.5 External content and artefact security
contracts.claim: Exact outbound payloads need deterministic security checks; natural-language sanitization is incomplete.

contracts.heading: 9.6 Repository-link portability
contracts.claim: External publication resolves safe repository-relative links and blocks machine-local or escaping paths.

contracts.heading: 10. Indexes and logs
contracts.claim: Producer-generated navigation and logs remain derived views.

contracts.heading: 11. Visualisation
contracts.claim: Producer visualisation requirements preserve relationship semantics and explicit coverage.

contracts.heading: 12. Conformance
contracts.claim: Document, bundle, producer, consumer and adapter conformance have independent requirements.
